questions.answer: There was a lot of trouble with the courses, because we couldn't choose the ones we thought we could. But it was possible to change when I arrived.

questions.answer: The administration at the school. But their english was difficult to understand.

questions.answer: I didn't get the ones I wanted. But I was able to choose them later.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Go to the administration, they can help you.

questions.answer: It was a low academic level

questions.answer: It was an undergraduate course, so it wasn't that challenging. And many of the subjects were small, so it became very superficial

questions.answer: It was difficult to understand their English. Generally much lower academic level
